text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Looks like the overcast skies are going to stick around...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
How did all the Tiara Umamusume
bounce back at times like this, I wonder...
choice_data_list: Even the most incredible people have off days.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
choice_data_list: Your efforts are in no way inferior to theirs.
Your hard work is second to none compared to theirs.
Everyone's been running frantically non-stop, you know.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
choice_data_list: Your efforts are in no way inferior to theirs.
Your hard work is second to none compared to theirs.
Everyone's been running frantically non-stop, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hard work will always answer in kind.
I urged them to believe that time will come and keep pushing forward without giving up.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe,
I'm starting to feel a little braver now.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I can't afford to be timid.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trusting in the path I've walked,
I'll take on the next challenge!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone keeps running, gritting their teeth through defeat.
Because if you stop,
your path ends right there—she gently reminded them.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Never giving up"...
that's what it really means, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, through the break in the clouds...
I feel like I can see a little bit of light.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
In order not to lose... I need to train
even harder and more than before!
